mapper.sql: id, user_id, product_detail_id, quantity, selected, gmt_created, gmt_modified
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart (user_id, product_detail_id, quantity, selected, gmt_created, gmt_modified) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productDetailId}, #{quantity}, #{selected}, #{gmtCreated}, #{gmtModified}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = quantity + VALUES(quantity), gmt_modified = NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_detail_id = #{productDetailId}
DELETE FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND selected = 1
mapper.select: SELECT FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY gmt_created DESC
